heroes.name: Solenne
heroes.title: The Sunforged Envoy

signature.name: Solar Accord
signature.text: Give an allied unit Shield and +1/+1 permanently.

heroes.story: A treaty keeper who carries a ward instead of a crown. Solenne holds a contested lane long enough for reinforcements to arrive.
heroes.strategy: Protect a valuable unit, then move it away from unfavorable exchanges.
heroes.counterplay: Hard removal and wide pressure punish investment in one unit.
heroes.alt: Solenne, The Sunforged Envoy, a protective duelist with slender spear triangle and ivory, navy, copper gold colors.

heroes.name: Cairn
heroes.title: The Keystone Guardian

signature.name: Keystone Covenant
signature.text: Give an allied unit Armor and +0/+2 permanently.

heroes.story: Built to shelter a city, Cairn now walks the Fivefold carrying its last living seed.
heroes.strategy: Build a durable blocker and force the opponent to spend more than one card answering it.
heroes.counterplay: Movement and effects that destroy units directly bypass a defensive stat advantage.
heroes.alt: Cairn, The Keystone Guardian, a enduring defender with broad stone arch and limestone, moss teal, gold colors.

heroes.name: Zephyr
heroes.title: The Crosswind Runner

signature.name: Crosswind
signature.text: Move an allied unit to an empty allied lane. Give it +3 ATK this turn. Draw a card.

heroes.story: A courier who reads the broken winds between lanes. Zephyr wins by arriving where the enemy has stopped looking.
heroes.strategy: Preserve a healthy unit and reposition it into an open attack lane.
heroes.counterplay: Full allied boards restrict movement; Stun interrupts a planned attack.
heroes.alt: Zephyr, The Crosswind Runner, a mobile tempo with lean scarf diagonal and ivory, seafoam, indigo colors.

heroes.name: Meridian
heroes.title: The Dawn Archivist

signature.name: Held Dawn
signature.text: Stun an enemy unit this turn. Heal your hero for 3. Draw a card.

heroes.story: Meridian records the promises that survive each war. Her astronomical instruments guide precise interventions; they do not rewind time.
heroes.strategy: Delay a large attacker while restoring resources and finding your next answer.
heroes.counterplay: Multiple threats outpace a single Stun; Stun does not remove blockers or triggers.
heroes.alt: Meridian, The Dawn Archivist, a measured control with straight scholar rectangle and navy, ivory, amber brass colors.

heroes.name: Mossweld
heroes.title: The Grove Mechanic

signature.name: Field Refit
signature.text: Heal an allied unit for 4. Give it Shield. Draw a card.

heroes.story: Mossweld rebuilds what the front line leaves behind. Her seed kiln joins living fibers to practical machinery.
heroes.strategy: Repair a damaged survivor before the next exchange and retain card advantage.
heroes.counterplay: Full-health targets waste the heal; direct destruction ignores repaired HP.
heroes.alt: Mossweld, The Grove Mechanic, a field maintenance with compact gauntlet asymmetry and olive, ivory, copper, teal colors.

heroes.name: Halcyon
heroes.title: The Sky Chorus

signature.name: Skyward Chorus
signature.text: Give all allied units +1 ATK this turn and heal them for 1.

heroes.story: The last cantor of an airborne sanctuary, Halcyon coordinates scattered allies through resonant crystal tones.
heroes.strategy: Develop several lanes before using a formation-wide combat boost.
heroes.counterplay: Board wipes and thin allied boards reduce the signature's value.
heroes.alt: Halcyon, The Sky Chorus, a formation support with tall avian feather fan and ivory, indigo, pale gold colors.

heroes.name: Rowan
heroes.title: The Grove Nomad

signature.name: Hearthroot
signature.text: Summon a Seedling in an empty allied lane. Heal your hero for 4.

heroes.story: Rowan carries seeds from settlements that no longer stand. Each camp he leaves behind becomes a small refuge.
heroes.strategy: Stabilize a losing board with a blocker while recovering hero health.
heroes.counterplay: A full board prevents the summon; sustained pressure can overwhelm a small token.
heroes.alt: Rowan, The Grove Nomad, a patient sustain with staff and layered traveling coat and moss, ochre, ivory, brown colors.

heroes.name: Rook
heroes.title: The Cinder Marksman

signature.name: Crossfire Oath
signature.text: Move an enemy unit to an empty lane on its side. Deal 2 damage to it.

heroes.story: Rook tracks the gaps between defensive lines. A single redirected target is often enough to open the route forward.
heroes.strategy: Move a blocker out of the lane you want to attack, then finish a weakened target.
heroes.counterplay: A full enemy board denies movement; Armor and Shield reduce the follow-up damage.
heroes.alt: Rook, The Cinder Marksman, a tactical displacement with rail-bow diagonal and charcoal, rust, bone, ember colors.

heroes.name: Nyxara
heroes.title: The Silk Hex

signature.name: Thread the Needle
signature.text: Move an enemy unit to an empty lane on its side. Poison it.

heroes.silhouette: slim coat with six ribbon strands
heroes.story: Nyxara weaves binding oaths into silent threads. Her control is patient, forcing enemies to fight on terms they did not choose.
heroes.strategy: Displace durable defenders and let Poison tax them across turns.
heroes.counterplay: Armor and Shield can absorb Poison packets; full lanes restrict her signature.
heroes.alt: Nyxara, The Silk Hex, a positional attrition with slim coat with six ribbon strands and plum, charcoal, turquoise colors.

heroes.name: Brimstone
heroes.title: The Crucible Colossus

signature.name: Crucible Break
signature.text: Deal 3 damage to an enemy unit, then 1 damage to the enemy hero.

heroes.story: An abandoned siege furnace given purpose, Brimstone treats every fortification as ore awaiting the hammer.
heroes.strategy: Remove a medium defender while maintaining direct pressure on the enemy hero.
heroes.counterplay: Shield absorbs a damage packet; efficient healing can offset the hero damage.
heroes.alt: Brimstone, The Crucible Colossus, a removal pressure with heavy obsidian trapezoid and obsidian, burnt iron, ember colors.

heroes.name: Sable
heroes.title: The Last Adjudicator

signature.name: Final Injunction
signature.text: Give an enemy unit -2 ATK this turn. Poison it. Draw a card.

heroes.story: Sable enforces judgments written before the factions split. His ink seals turn powerful enemies into costly liabilities.
heroes.strategy: Reduce an immediate attack and establish a longer attrition threat.
heroes.counterplay: ATK penalties do not stop triggered abilities; Poison does not stack.
heroes.alt: Sable, The Last Adjudicator, a suppressive control with tall judicial rectangle and charcoal, bone, plum colors.

heroes.name: Vanta
heroes.title: The Blackglass Dancer

signature.name: Blackglass Waltz
signature.text: Move an allied unit to an empty allied lane. Give it +1 ATK and Pierce this turn.

heroes.silhouette: narrow S curve and blade hoops
heroes.story: Vanta learned to move through the reflections of broken glass. Every feint conceals the angle of the final strike.
heroes.strategy: Reposition a strong attacker; Pierce adds a separate full-ATK hero packet while that unit attacks a blocker.
heroes.counterplay: Stun or removal before attack declaration stops the strike; reducing the attacker’s ATK reduces both packets. A durable blocker does not absorb Pierce’s hero packet.
heroes.alt: Vanta, The Blackglass Dancer, a mobile finisher with narrow S curve and blade hoops and blackglass, plum, silver, crimson colors.

heroes.name: Gravemarch
heroes.title: The Hollow Bell

signature.name: Toll of Cinders
signature.text: Summon a Cinderling in an empty allied lane. Deal 1 damage to all enemy units.

heroes.story: Gravemarch once announced the return of a victorious army. Now its bell calls only the embers that followed them home.
heroes.strategy: Add a body while removing fragile units or consuming enemy Shields.
heroes.counterplay: Armor can negate the sweep, and a full allied board blocks the signature.
heroes.alt: Gravemarch, The Hollow Bell, a board attrition with blocky bell-cage automaton and soot, bronze, teal patina colors.

heroes.name: Scoria
heroes.title: The Ash Alchemist

signature.name: Ashen Remedy
signature.text: Deal 2 damage to an enemy unit. Heal your hero for 3. Draw a card.

heroes.silhouette: split laboratory coat and twin vessels
heroes.story: Scoria extracts useful life from the residue of battle. Her portable kilns turn controlled destruction into another chance to endure.
heroes.strategy: Trade against a small enemy while recovering health and maintaining hand size.
heroes.counterplay: Shield and Armor weaken removal; wide boards demand more than one answer.
heroes.alt: Scoria, The Ash Alchemist, a resource attrition with split laboratory coat and twin vessels and ash, charcoal, copper, crimson colors.
